dedupeResult: The active pull-request branch was searched for each platform name, canonical domain and official submission route before creation. No existing music-submission-agent records were found for Liquicity, Circus Records/Circus Electric or Monstercat. Related imprints and multiple official endpoints were consolidated into one opportunity and one queue row per organization to prevent duplicate outreach.
emailVerificationLevel: Circus publishes info@circus-records.co.uk on its official first-party page for questions and requests. Its syntax, first-party domain and published business purpose were checked, but Circus explicitly requires demos through LabelRadar only, so the address was not queued for music delivery. Liquicity publishes no plaintext demo mailbox. Monstercat exposes separate support, press and event contact links, but these are not demo routes and protected addresses were not decoded or stored. No address was guessed or repurposed, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, form, demo or submission was sent; no account was created or used; no LabelRadar or Label Engine login, credit, pricing or upload workflow was entered; no MP3, track, link, artwork, biography, metadata, rights declaration, consent or personal data was supplied; no cookie choice, CAPTCHA, anti-spam, anti-bot, payment or platform restriction was bypassed; no protected contact was decoded; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
